title: A Plausible Future Is Not a Causal Future: Can Video Models Generate How the World Unfolds?
title_zh: 可信的未来并非因果的未来：视频模型能否生成世界的发展过程？

paragraphs.en: Large-scale video generation models are increasingly viewed as a promising path toward world models, yet their ability to capture causally coherent physical dynamics remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely emphasize visual quality, prompt adherence, or broad physical plausibility, leaving open whether a model can faithfully realize a complete causal cascade, in which an initiating event propagates through causally dependent interactions to a terminal outcome. We introduce CausalCascade , a simulator-grounded benchmark centered on 50 event-rich Blender scenes with structured event graphs, graph-grounded diagnostic VQA, three levels of future-event specification, and 2,832 controlled counterfactual variants, and use it to evaluate nine image-to-video models with complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics. Across the evaluated models, generated motion is more reliably localized spatially than realized with correct spatiotemporal evolution, while richer future-event specification improves event recovery but leaves physical realization limited. Counterfactual evaluation further reveals weak selective responsiveness to physical interventions, while most audited failures are foundational, arising at scene consistency or event occurrence. Together, these results position causal cascade generation as a process-level test of world modeling and highlight the need to jointly recover the intended future, faithfully realize its physical evolution, selectively respond to physical interventions, and maintain a coherent physical world over time. Code and dataset are available at GitHub and Hugging Face respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模视频生成模型日益被视为通往世界模型的一条有前景的路径，但它们捕捉因果连贯的物理动态的能力仍鲜为人知。 现有的评估主要强调视觉质量、提示遵循性或广泛的物理合理性，但并未明确模型是否能够忠实地实现完整的因果级联——即一个初始事件通过因果依赖的相互作用传播至最终结果的过程。 我们提出了 CausalCascade，这是一个以模拟器为基础、以 50 个富含事件的 Blender 场景为核心的基准测试，这些场景具有结构化的事件图、基于图的诊断性 VQA、三个层级的未来事件指定以及 2,832 种受控的反事实变体；我们用它来评估九种图像到视频模型，并辅以运动、事件和反事实层面的互补性诊断。 在所有被评估的模型中，生成的运动在空间上的定位比实现正确的时空演化更为可靠，而更丰富的未来事件指定虽然能提升事件恢复能力，但物理实现的局限性依然存在。 反事实评估进一步揭示了模型对物理干预的选择性响应较弱，而大多数经审计的失败都是基础性的，源于场景一致性或事件发生问题。 综合来看，这些结果表明因果级联生成是世界建模的过程层面测试，并凸显了需要同时恢复预期的未来、忠实地实现其物理演化、选择性地响应物理干预，并在时间上维持一个连贯的物理世界。 代码和数据集分别可在 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 上获取。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large-scale video generation have made video generation models a promising route toward world models, as they show potential for predicting how physical scenes evolve under given conditions ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) . Such predictive capability is central to applications such as robotic manipulation ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , autonomous driving ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , and interactive world simulation ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) , where effective decision-making depends on anticipating how the physical world will respond to actions and environmental changes. For such predictions to be useful, however, it is not enough for models to generate a single visually plausible event; they must produce a chain of events that is consistent with the physical consequences implied by the scene and the actions ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) , as physical consistency concerns not only whether individual events appear plausible, but also whether the interactions connecting them form a physically coherent evolution over time.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模视频生成领域的最新进展使视频生成模型成为构建世界模型的一条有前景的途径，因为它们展现出预测物理场景在给定条件下如何演化的潜力（Brooks 等，2024；Bruce 等，2024；NVIDIA 等，2025；Qin 等，2025）。 这种预测能力对于机器人操作（Zhou 等，2024）、自动驾驶（Gao 等，2024；Wang 等，2025）和交互式世界模拟（Bruce 等，2024）等应用至关重要，因为在这些应用中，有效的决策取决于对物理世界如何响应动作和环境变化的预测。 然而，要使这类预测真正有用，模型仅生成单个在视觉上看似合理的事件是不够的；它们必须生成一个与场景和动作所暗示的物理后果相一致的事件链（Motamed 等，2026），因为物理一致性不仅涉及单个事件是否看起来合理，还涉及连接这些事件的相互作用是否在时间上构成一种物理上连贯的演化过程。

paragraphs.en: Many physical consequences unfold through a sequence of causally dependent events. A collision may set an object in motion, causing it to strike another body, which in turn triggers a downstream outcome. We refer to this multi-stage, causally connected process as a causal cascade . Recent work has begun to recognize such cross-event causal progression as an important challenge for physically plausible video generation ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Gillman et al., 2026 ) , but existing evaluations do not directly assess this capability. On the one hand, video-generation benchmarks assess perceptual quality, physical plausibility, adherence to physical principles, or agreement with reference dynamics ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Bansal et al., 2024 ; Bansal et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Motamed et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , but they do not directly determine whether the causal dependencies between events are correctly realized. On the other hand, causal and counterfactual benchmarks probe dynamics prediction, causal relations, and responses to hypothetical changes ( Bakhtin et al., 2019 ; Riochet et al., 2022 ; Bear et al., 2021 ; Tung et al., 2023 ; Yi et al., 2020 ; Baradel et al., 2020 ; Ates et al., 2022 ; Foss et al., 2025 ) , but typically evaluate causal prediction or reasoning rather than whether causal relations are instantiated in generated content.
paragraphs.zh: 许多物理后果是通过一系列具有因果依赖性的事件逐步展开的。 一次碰撞可能使某个物体开始运动，导致它撞击另一个物体，而后者又会触发后续的结果。 我们将这种多阶段、具有因果关联的过程称为因果级联。 近期的研究开始认识到，这种跨事件的因果推进是生成物理上可信视频的一项重要挑战（Wang et al., 2026；Gillman et al., 2026），但现有的评估并未直接检验这一能力。 一方面，视频生成基准测试会评估感知质量、物理可信度、对物理原理的遵循程度或与参考动态的一致性（Huang et al., 2024；Huang et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2024；Bansal et al., 2024；Bansal et al., 2026；Meng et al., 2025；Hu et al., 2025；Motamed et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026），但它们并未直接判断事件之间的因果依赖关系是否被正确实现。 另一方面，因果与反事实基准测试会探究动态预测、因果关系以及对假设性变化的响应（Bakhtin et al., 2019；Riochet et al., 2022；Bear et al., 2021；Tung et al., 2023；Yi et al., 2020；Baradel et al., 2020；Ates et al., 2022；Foss et al., 2025），但它们通常评估的是因果预测或推理能力，而非因果关系是否被具体体现在生成内容中。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we introduce CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark to evaluate whether image-to-video (I2V) models realize the complete causal process underlying a rollout (Figure 1 ). We construct 50 event-rich Blender scenes and represent reference rollouts with a structured event graph. This representation enables evaluation at two levels: motion-based metrics measure whether physical activity is realized in the correct space and time, while graph-grounded VQA diagnoses whether the events and dependencies are recovered. To separate knowing what should happen from realizing how it happens, we further consider three future-event specification levels: state-only, trigger-aware, and full event-chain prompts. We also construct 2,832 controlled variants through delete , move , scale , and mass interventions, enabling evaluation of whether intervention effects propagate to the dynamics that depend on them while unaffected dynamics remain preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 CausalCascade——一个以模拟器为基础的性能基准，用于评估图像到视频（I2V）模型是否实现了滚动过程背后的完整因果过程（图 1）。 我们构建了 50 个富含事件的 Blender 场景，并使用结构化的事件图来表示参考滚动过程。 这种表示方法支持两个层面的评估：基于运动的指标用于衡量物理活动是否在正确的时间和空间中实现，而基于图的视觉问答（VQA）则用于判断事件及其依赖关系是否被准确还原。 为了将“知道应该发生什么”与“实现其发生的方式”区分开来，我们进一步考虑了三种未来事件描述层次：仅状态提示、触发感知提示和完整事件链提示。 我们还通过删除、移动、缩放和质量干预等方式构建了 2,832 个受控变体，从而能够评估干预效应是否传播到依赖它们的动态过程，同时未受影响的动态过程是否得以保留。

sents.en: To separate knowing what should happen from realizing how it happens, we further consider three future-event specification levels: state-only, trigger-aware, and full event-chain prompts.
sents.zh: 为了将“知道应该发生什么”与“实现其发生的方式”区分开来，我们进一步考虑了三种未来事件描述层次：仅状态提示、触发感知提示和完整事件链提示。

paragraphs.en: Across nine current I2V models, our evaluations reveal three gaps that limit their use as faithful world models. First, more explicit information about what should happen helps event recovery, but both event-level performance and the faithful realization of how the causal process unfolds remain limited. Second, a world model must do more than produce a different future when the physical world changes. It should selectively propagate the consequences of that change through affected dynamics while preserving those that are causally unaffected, yet current models struggle with both requirements. Third, many rollouts fail at scene consistency or event occurrence, revealing a more foundational limitation: models often fail to establish a persistent physical world in which stable entities and events can support sustained causal propagation. These failures suggest that faithful causal cascade generation requires maintaining a persistent physical world with coherent entities and physical states, a foundational requirement for video models to function as causal world models.
paragraphs.zh: 通过对当前九种 I2V 模型的评估，我们发现存在三个限制其作为忠实世界模型使用的不足。 首先，关于“应发生什么”的更明确信息有助于事件恢复，但事件层面的表现以及对因果过程如何展开的忠实呈现仍然有限。 其次，当物理世界发生变化时，一个世界模型必须做的不仅仅是生成一个不同的未来。 它应当选择性地将该变化的后果通过受影响的动态过程传播出去，同时保留那些在因果上未受影响的部分，然而当前模型在这两个要求上都存在困难。 第三，许多模拟运行在场景一致性或事件发生方面出现失败，这揭示了一个更根本的局限：这些模型往往无法建立一个持久的物理世界，其中稳定的实体和事件能够支持持续的因果传播。 这些失败表明，要生成忠实的因果级联，需要维持一个包含连贯实体和物理状态的持久物理世界，这是视频模型作为因果世界模型运行的基础要求。

sents.en: Third, many rollouts fail at scene consistency or event occurrence, revealing a more foundational limitation: models often fail to establish a persistent physical world in which stable entities and events can support sustained causal propagation.

paragraphs.en: We formulate causal cascade generation as a process-level evaluation target for I2V models, asking whether causally dependent events are faithfully realized as a coherent process.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将因果级联生成定义为I2V模型的一项过程层面评估目标，旨在考察因果依赖的事件是否被忠实地实现为一个连贯的过程。

paragraphs.en: We introduce CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark that combines structured event graphs, controlled future-event specification, and physical interventions to evaluate causal cascade generation from complementary perspectives.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 CausalCascade，这是一个以模拟器为基础的性能基准，它结合了结构化事件图、受控的未来事件规格以及物理干预，旨在从互补的视角评估因果级联的生成能力。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate nine I2V models, exposing a gap between event recovery and causal realization: future-event specification improves what happens more than how it unfolds, intervention responses remain weakly selective, and audited failures cluster at foundational stages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了九种 I2V 模型，揭示了事件恢复与因果实现之间的差距：未来事件的规范对“发生什么”的影响大于对“如何展开”的影响，干预响应仍然缺乏选择性，而经过审计的失败则集中在基础阶段。

paragraphs.en: Physical Evaluation of Video Generation. General-purpose video generation benchmarks evaluate perceptual quality, temporal consistency, motion quality, and prompt alignment ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Physics-oriented benchmarks further evaluate whether generated dynamics are physically plausible or agree with reference behavior ( Bansal et al., 2024 ; Bansal et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Tragoudaras et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . For example, Physics-IQ ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) derives motion representations from generated and reference videos and evaluates their agreement using spatial, spatiotemporal, and motion-frequency metrics. WorldBench ( Upadhyay et al., 2026 ) constructs tests that isolate physical concepts to attribute failures to specific aspects of physical understanding. These benchmarks provide increasingly detailed measures of physical fidelity, but place less emphasis on whether interactions are organized into the correct multi-stage causal process and satisfy the dependencies between successive events.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成的物理评估。 通用视频生成基准测试会评估感知质量、时间一致性、运动质量和提示对齐程度（Huang 等，2024；Huang 等，2026；Liu 等，2024）。 面向物理学的基准测试进一步评估生成的动态是否符合物理合理性或与参考行为一致（Bansal 等，2024；Bansal 等，2026；Meng 等，2025；Hu 等，2025；Tragoudaras 等，2026；Li 等，2026；Gu 等，2026；Zhou 等，2026）。 例如，Physics-IQ（Motamed 等，2026）从生成的视频和参考视频中提取运动表示，并利用空间、时空和运动频率指标评估二者的一致性。 WorldBench（Upadhyay 等，2026）构建了一系列测试，能够隔离特定的物理概念，从而将失败归因于物理理解的特定方面。 这些基准测试为物理保真度提供了越来越详细的衡量标准，但较少关注交互是否被组织成正确的多阶段因果过程，以及是否满足连续事件之间的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Causal and Counterfactual Evaluation. Physical and causal reasoning benchmarks study dynamics prediction, temporal and causal reasoning, and counterfactual inference as reasoning or prediction tasks ( Bakhtin et al., 2019 ; Riochet et al., 2022 ; Bear et al., 2021 ; Tung et al., 2023 ; Yi et al., 2020 ; Ates et al., 2022 ; Baradel et al., 2020 ; Mao et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Foss et al., 2025 ) . More recent work extends intervention-based evaluation to video and world models. CRONOS ( Begiristain et al., 2026 ) evaluates whether predictions of physical events remain consistent under scene and object changes, while YoCausal ( Xie et al., 2026 ) probes temporal causal sensitivity using forward and time-reversed real-world videos. What-If World ( Cai et al., 2026 ) is closely related to our setting: it evaluates paired generations in which one physical detail is changed, testing whether shared scene content is preserved while the expected physical consequence changes.
paragraphs.zh: 因果与反事实评估。 物理与因果推理基准研究动态预测、时序与因果推理以及反事实推断作为推理或预测任务（Bakhtin 等，2019；Riochet 等，2022；Bear 等，2021；Tung 等，2023；Yi 等，2020；Ates 等，2022；Baradel 等，2020；Mao 等，2022；Chen 等，2022；Zheng 等，2024；Foss 等，2025）。 近期的研究将基于干预的评估方法扩展到了视频和世界模型。 CRONOS（Begiristain 等，2026）评估物理事件的预测在场景和物体变化下是否保持一致，而 YoCausal（Xie 等，2026）则通过正向和反向播放的真实世界视频来探究时序因果敏感性。 What-If World（Cai 等，2026）与我们的设定密切相关：它评估成对的生成结果，其中一项物理细节被改变，以测试共享的场景内容是否得以保留，而预期的物理后果是否随之变化。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these lines of work evaluate either the physical fidelity of generated dynamics or causal and counterfactual responses, but place less emphasis on whether a model realizes the complete causal process connecting successive events. Also, causal cascade generation further requires examining whether interventions alter causally dependent dynamics while preserving unaffected ones. To support this evaluation, CausalCascade provides complete causal-process rollouts with controlled interventions and combines motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics. Table 1 compares CausalCascade with existing physical, causal, and counterfactual benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些研究要么评估所生成动态的物理保真度，要么检验因果和反事实响应，但较少关注模型是否实现了连接连续事件的完整因果过程。 此外，因果级联生成还需要进一步检验：干预措施是否在改变因果依赖的动态的同时，保持未受影响的动态不变。 为支持这种评估，CausalCascade 提供了带有受控干预的完整因果过程展开，并结合了运动、事件和反事实层面的诊断方法。 表 1 将 CausalCascade 与现有的物理、因果和反事实基准进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: We organize CausalCascade around three research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 CausalCascade 的组织围绕三个研究问题展开：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How well can current I2V models faithfully generate complete causal cascades?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：当前的图像到视频模型在忠实地生成完整的因果级联方面表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Can the I2V models selectively update causal futures under physical interventions?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：I2V模型能否在物理干预下选择性地更新因果未来？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: What are the main failure modes in current causal cascade generation?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：当前因果级联生成中的主要失效模式是什么？

paragraphs.en: Together, these questions examine complementary aspects of causal cascade generation: faithful realization, selective responsiveness to physical interventions, and failure localization.
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题共同探讨了因果级联生成的互补方面：忠实实现、对物理干预的选择性响应以及故障定位。

paragraphs.en: A causal cascade is a multi-stage physical process in which downstream events depend on states produced by earlier interactions. We consider a physical scene 𝒮 \mathcal{S} with a current physical state and its corresponding future evolution under the simulator. The simulator renders an initial frame I 0 I_{0} and a reference rollout V ∗ V^{*} that records the event-rich physical evolution of the scene from that state. We formulate causal cascade generation as the task of generating the complete process from only the initial observation I 0 I_{0} and a textual condition u u :
paragraphs.zh: 因果级联是一种多阶段物理过程，其中下游事件依赖于早期相互作用所产生的状态。 我们考虑一个物理场景 𝒮 \mathcal{S}，它包含当前的物理状态以及在模拟器下该状态的对应未来演化过程。 模拟器会渲染一个初始帧 I 0 I_{0} 和一个参考展开序列 V ∗ V^{*}，后者记录了从该状态开始的场景中富含事件的物理演化过程。 我们将因果级联生成问题表述为：仅根据初始观测 I 0 I_{0} 和文本条件 u u : 来生成完整过程的任务。

sents.en: A causal cascade is a multi-stage physical process in which downstream events depend on states produced by earlier interactions.
sents.zh: 因果级联是一种多阶段物理过程，其中下游事件依赖于早期相互作用所产生的状态。

sents.en: We consider a physical scene 𝒮 \mathcal{S} with a current physical state and its corresponding future evolution under the simulator.
sents.zh: 我们考虑一个物理场景 𝒮 \mathcal{S}，它包含当前的物理状态以及在模拟器下该状态的对应未来演化过程。

sents.en: The simulator renders an initial frame I 0 I_{0} and a reference rollout V ∗ V^{*} that records the event-rich physical evolution of the scene from that state.

sents.en: We formulate causal cascade generation as the task of generating the complete process from only the initial observation I 0 I_{0} and a textual condition u u :
sents.zh: 我们将因果级联生成问题表述为：仅根据初始观测 I 0 I_{0} 和文本条件 u u : 来生成完整过程的任务。

paragraphs.en: The initial frame specifies the observable entities, geometry, and spatial relations of the scene, while the textual condition provides complementary physical information. The generation target is not merely a plausible event or final outcome but a coherent process in which causal consequences are sustained across successive interactions. Notably, the textual condition also provides a controlled interface for varying how explicitly the intended future process is specified.
paragraphs.zh: 初始帧定义了场景中可观测的实体、几何形状和空间关系，而文本条件则提供了补充的物理信息。 生成目标不仅仅是某个看似合理的事件或最终结果，而是一个连贯的过程，其中因果后果在连续交互中得以维持。 值得注意的是，文本条件还提供了一个受控的接口，用于调整对预期未来过程的描述明确程度。

sents.en: The initial frame specifies the observable entities, geometry, and spatial relations of the scene, while the textual condition provides complementary physical information.
sents.zh: 初始帧定义了场景中可观测的实体、几何形状和空间关系，而文本条件则提供了补充的物理信息。

sents.en: The generation target is not merely a plausible event or final outcome but a coherent process in which causal consequences are sustained across successive interactions.
sents.zh: 生成目标不仅仅是某个看似合理的事件或最终结果，而是一个连贯的过程，其中因果后果在连续交互中得以维持。

sents.en: Notably, the textual condition also provides a controlled interface for varying how explicitly the intended future process is specified.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，文本条件还提供了一个受控的接口，用于调整对预期未来过程的描述明确程度。

paragraphs.en: Because a causal cascade unfolds through dependent stages, fidelity must be maintained throughout the process rather than judged from isolated events or the final outcome. We therefore characterize causal fidelity through two complementary requirements. First, causally relevant activity should occur in the appropriate regions and evolve consistently through time. Second, the generated rollout should realize the expected events and causal dependencies that connect the initiating event, intermediate interactions, and downstream outcome. To represent these event dependencies explicitly, we associate each reference rollout V ∗ V^{*} with a causal event graph G ∗ G^{*} to capture the organization of the intended cascade beyond pixel-level similarity.
paragraphs.zh: 由于因果级联通过相互依赖的阶段展开，因此必须在整个过程中保持保真度，而不能仅根据孤立事件或最终结果来判断。 因此，我们通过两个互补的要求来定义因果保真度。 首先，具有因果相关性的活动应出现在适当的区域中，并随时间一致演化。 其次，生成的展开过程应实现预期的事件和因果依赖关系，这些关系将初始事件、中间相互作用和下游结果连接起来。 为了明确表示这些事件依赖关系，我们将每个参考展开 V* V^{*} 与一个因果事件图 G* G^{*} 关联起来，以捕捉超越像素级相似性的预期级联结构。

sents.zh: 其次，生成的展开过程应实现预期的事件和因果依赖关系，这些关系将初始事件、中间相互作用和下游结果连接起来。

sents.zh: 为了明确表示这些事件依赖关系，我们将每个参考展开 V* V^{*} 与一个因果事件图 G* G^{*} 关联起来，以捕捉超越像素级相似性的预期级联结构。

paragraphs.en: Faithfully generating a causal cascade requires the model both to infer what future process is implied by the current state and to physically realize how that process unfolds. These demands are coupled because the model must infer not only an immediate event but also the downstream event structure linked through successive interactions. We therefore use the textual condition u u as an interface for varying how explicitly the future process is specified. Increasing the explicitness of future-event specification reduces the need to infer the intended event structure while retaining the requirement to generate the corresponding physical evolution. Comparisons across specification conditions thus help distinguish future-event inference from physical realization within the same generation task.
paragraphs.zh: 忠实地生成因果级联需要模型既能推断出当前状态所暗示的未来过程，又能实际实现该过程的展开方式。 这些需求是相互耦合的，因为模型不仅要推断出即时事件，还要推断出通过连续相互作用关联起来的下游事件结构。 因此，我们将文本条件 u u 用作接口，以调整未来过程的指定明确程度。 提高未来事件指定的明确性，可以减少对预期事件结构的推断需求，同时仍需生成相应的物理演化过程。 因此，在不同指定条件下的比较有助于在同一生成任务中区分未来事件的推断与物理实现。

paragraphs.en: For a world model, causal fidelity for a given scene is not enough; the generated future should also respond selectively when the underlying physical state changes. This requires capturing the causal dependencies through which the effects of that change propagate across the cascade. In a multi-stage process, changing one physical factor may alter downstream interactions that depend on it while leaving other dynamics unaffected. To test this selective propagation, we introduce controlled interventions on selected physical factors of the scene.
paragraphs.zh: 对于世界模型而言，仅对给定场景保持因果保真度是不够的；生成的未来状态在底层物理状态发生变化时，也应能够做出选择性响应。 这要求模型捕捉到因果依赖关系，即这种变化所产生的影响如何在整个级联过程中传播。 在多阶段流程中，改变一个物理因素可能会改变依赖于该因素的下游相互作用，而其他动态过程则不受影响。 为了检验这种选择性传播，我们对场景中的选定物理因素引入受控干预。

sents.zh: 为了检验这种选择性传播，我们对场景中的选定物理因素引入受控干预。

paragraphs.en: Given a factual scene 𝒮 f \mathcal{S}^{f} , an intervention T k T_{k} modifies a controlled physical factor to produce a corresponding counterfactual scene
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个事实场景 𝒮 f \mathcal{S}^{f}，干预 T k T_{k} 会改变一个受控的物理因素，从而产生一个相应的反事实场景。

paragraphs.en: yielding matched reference rollouts ( V f ∗ , V c f ∗ ) (V^{f*},V^{cf*}) and generated rollouts ( V ^ f , V ^ c ​ f ) (\hat{V}^{f},\hat{V}^{cf}) .
paragraphs.zh: 得到匹配的参考展开序列 ( V f ∗ , V c f ∗ ) (V^{f*},V^{cf*}) 和生成的展开序列 ( V ^ f , V ^ c ​ f ) (\hat{V}^{f},\hat{V}^{cf})。

paragraphs.en: A causally responsive model should propagate the consequences of the intervention through the affected parts of the cascade without perturbing unaffected dynamics. Dynamics that change between the reference rollouts ( V f ∗ , V c f ∗ ) (V^{f*},V^{cf*}) should change correspondingly between the generated rollouts ( V ^ f , V ^ c ​ f ) (\hat{V}^{f},\hat{V}^{cf}) , while dynamics shared by the reference pair should remain shared in the generated pair. Therefore, this paired formulation tests whether the generated causal process responds selectively to the modified physical state, rather than simply whether the paired generations differ.
paragraphs.zh: 一个具有因果响应的模型应当将干预的后果通过级联中受影响的部分传播出去，同时不干扰未受影响的动态过程。 在参考展开（V^{f*},V^{cf*}）之间发生变化的动态过程，应当在生成的展开（\hat{V}^{f},\hat{V}^{cf}）之间相应地发生变化；而参考对中共有的动态过程，则应在生成对中继续保持共有。 因此，这种成对的形式化方法检验的是：生成的因果过程是否对修改后的物理状态具有选择性响应，而不仅仅是检验成对的生成结果是否存在差异。

paragraphs.en: We construct 50 event-rich Blender scenes containing 954 rigid bodies. Figure 2 (left) summarizes their structural complexity in terms of objects, events, causal dependencies, and temporal depth. The scenes are selected to satisfy four principles: multi-stage causality , so success requires propagation through intermediate interactions; mechanism diversity , including interaction-rich and instability-driven processes; intervention sensitivity , so selected physical factors can causally alter downstream behavior; and observability , so relevant interaction paths remain visible. Each scene is built by instantiating a physical interaction motif, varying its geometry or topology, extending it with upstream triggers or downstream consequences, and fixing the visual setup. We export initial frame I 0 I_{0} , the reference rollout V ∗ V^{*} , and structured scene metadata. Detailed design principles, the full construction pipeline, and asset, physics, camera, and rendering settings are in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 50 个富含事件的 Blender 场景，其中包含 954 个刚体。 图 2（左）从对象、事件、因果依赖和时间深度等方面总结了这些场景的结构复杂性。 这些场景的选择遵循四项原则：多阶段因果性，即成功需要通过中间相互作用传播；机制多样性，包括富含相互作用的和由不稳定性驱动的过程；干预敏感性，即所选物理因素能够因果性地改变下游行为；以及可观察性，即相关的相互作用路径保持可见。 每个场景都通过实例化一个物理相互作用母题构建而成，同时变化其几何形状或拓扑结构，用上游触发器或下游后果进行扩展，并固定视觉设置。 我们导出了初始帧 I₀ I_{0}、参考展开序列 V* V^{*} 以及结构化场景元数据。 详细的设计原则、完整的构建流程，以及资源、物理、相机和渲染设置均见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: For each reference rollout V ∗ V^{*} , we annotate observable events and their direct causal dependencies to instantiate its causal event graph G ∗ G^{*} . From each graph, we deterministically derive a set of closed-ended diagnostic questions Q ∗ Q^{*} based on its events, dependencies, temporal stages, and participants. Each question is therefore traceable to a specific constraint in the reference causal process and serves as an event-level evaluation instance.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个参考展开 V * V^{*}，我们都会标注可观察事件及其直接的因果依赖关系，从而构建其因果事件图 G * G^{*}。 从每张图中，我们会基于其中的事件、依赖关系、时间阶段和参与者，确定性地推导出一组封闭式的诊断问题 Q * Q^{*}。 因此，每个问题都可以追溯到参考因果过程中的某个特定约束，并作为一个事件层面的评估实例。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate the controlled future-event specification introduced in Section 3.2 using three prompt conditions. Level 1 describes the current scene state and relevant physical conditions without specifying any future event. Level 2 additionally specifies the initiating event, providing the model with the trigger of the upcoming causal process while leaving the subsequent evolution unspecified. Level 3 provides a substantially more explicit description of the intended future by verbalizing the major event chain from initiation through intermediate interactions to the downstream outcome. Across these conditions, the principal controlled factor is therefore the explicitness of future-event specification rather than literal textual inclusion between prompts. Graph schemas, QA templates, prompt templates, and examples are provided in Appendices B and C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用三个提示条件，对第 3.2 节中介绍的受控未来事件规范进行实例化。 第 1 级描述当前场景状态和相关物理条件，但不指定任何未来事件。 第 2 级进一步指定了触发事件，为模型提供了即将发生的因果过程的触发因素，但后续演化过程则未作明确说明。 第 3 级对预期的未来进行了更为明确的描述，通过语言表述了从触发开始、经过中间相互作用直至最终结果的完整主要事件链。 因此，在这些条件中，主要的受控因素是未来事件规范的明确程度，而非提示之间字面意义上的文本包含关系。 图结构方案、问答模板、提示模板和示例均列于附录 B 和 C 中。

paragraphs.en: Starting from each base scene, we construct object-centric counterfactual variants by applying a single intervention to one selected object at a time. We consider four intervention types. Three are visually explicit and alter the initial RGB observation: delete removes the selected object, move changes its initial position, and scale changes its size or proportions. The fourth, mass , is visually latent, changing only the object’s mass while leaving the initial frame unchanged. Each counterfactual scene is independently re-simulated to obtain its reference rollout, yielding factual-counterfactual pairs grounded in separate physical simulations rather than manual video edits. We retain variants that alter downstream event structure as well as variants that affect only finer-grained motion or timing. After automatic validity checks and screening, the benchmark contains 2,832 counterfactual variants, whose intervention distribution is shown in Figure 2 (right). Detailed intervention generation and validation procedures are provided in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 从每个基础场景出发，我们对每次仅对单个选定对象施加一次干预，从而构建以对象为中心的反事实变体。 我们考虑了四种类型的干预。 其中三种在视觉上明确可见，并会改变初始的 RGB 观察结果：删除会移除所选对象，移动会改变其初始位置，而缩放则会改变其大小或比例。 第四种干预是质量，它在视觉上不可见，仅改变对象的质量，同时保持初始画面不变。 每个反事实场景都会被独立地重新模拟，以获得其参考演化过程，从而生成基于独立物理模拟而非手动视频编辑的事实-反事实配对。 我们既保留那些会改变下游事件结构的变体，也保留那些仅影响更精细运动或时间安排的变体。 经过自动有效性检查和筛选后，该基准数据集包含 2,832 个反事实变体，其干预分布如图 2（右）所示。 详细的干预生成与验证流程见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: Motion-level evaluation. Following Physics-IQ ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) , we extract spatially normalized motion maps from each reference and generated rollout. We measure their agreement using Spatial IoU, Strict ST-IoU, and Weighted Spatial IoU. Spatial IoU measures motion-region overlap, Strict ST-IoU additionally enforces fixed frame-level temporal correspondence, and Weighted Spatial IoU accounts for motion magnitude. Motion extraction and metric definitions are in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 运动层级的评估。 遵循 Physics-IQ（Motamed 等人，2026），我们从每个参考和生成的展开序列中提取空间归一化的运动图。 我们使用空间 IoU、严格 ST-IoU 和加权空间 IoU 来衡量它们的一致性。 空间 IoU 衡量运动区域的重叠程度，严格 ST-IoU 额外要求固定的帧级时间对应关系，而加权空间 IoU 则考虑了运动幅度。 运动提取和指标定义见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: Event-level evaluation. We evaluate whether the generated rollout realizes the reference causal process using the diagnostic questions Q ∗ Q^{*} derived from G ∗ G^{*} . A tool-augmented video-QA evaluator combines full-rollout inspection with temporally aligned views and object-centric evidence, producing dimension-level scores and an overall VQA score. Both motion- and event-level evaluations cover all 50 base scenes. Complete evaluation protocol and human validation are in Appendix B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 事件级评估。 我们使用从 G* 推导出的诊断问题 Q* 来评估生成的展开过程是否实现了参考因果过程。 一种工具增强的视频问答评估器将完整展开过程的检查与时间对齐的视图和以对象为中心的证据相结合，生成维度级分数和总体 VQA 分数。 运动级和事件级评估均覆盖了全部 50 个基础场景。 完整的评估协议和人工验证见附录 B.2。

paragraphs.en: Counterfactual evaluation. We operationalize causal responsiveness to physical interventions using two complementary motion-based criteria: Effect , which measures whether motion is correctly suppressed or induced by the intervention, and Preserve , which measures whether motion shared across the factual and counterfactual references remains preserved. We compute both in spatial and weighted-spatial forms, yielding CF Spatial/Weighted Effect IoU and CF Preserve Spatial/Weighted IoU. Our designated counterfactual evaluation subset contains 225 model-blind factual-counterfactual pairs: 50 delete, 50 move, 50 scale, and 75 mass interventions. Each pair uses matched Level 1 prompts, with only intervention-affected attributes updated between the factual and counterfactual conditions, and scores are macro-averaged across represented base scenes. Screening and subset-selection details are in Appendix D.5 , and exact metric definitions are in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 反事实评估。 我们使用两个互补的运动相关标准来将因果响应性操作化：Effect，用于衡量运动是否被干预正确抑制或引发；以及 Preserve，用于衡量事实参考与反事实参考之间共享的运动是否得以保留。 我们在空间形式和加权空间形式下分别计算这两个指标，得到 CF Spatial/Weighted Effect IoU 和 CF Preserve Spatial/Weighted IoU。 我们指定的反事实评估子集包含 225 对模型无关的事实-反事实样本：50 个删除干预、50 个移动干预、50 个缩放干预以及 75 个质量干预。 每对样本均使用匹配的 Level 1 提示，仅更新受干预影响的属性以区分事实条件与反事实条件，且分数基于所有基础场景进行宏观平均计算。 筛选和子集选择的细节见附录 D.5，具体指标定义见附录 F。

paragraphs.en: Evaluated models. We evaluate nine representative open-source I2V models spanning diverse model families and scales: CogVideoX-Fun-V1.5 ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Alibaba PAI, 2025 ) , Cosmos3-Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , HunyuanVideo-I2V ( Kong et al., 2025 ) , LTX-Video-13B ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ) , MAGI-1-4.5B ( Sand.ai et al., 2025 ) , SkyReels-V2-I2V ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , Wan2.1-I2V-14B, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, and Wan2.2-I2V-A14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . We select models that are publicly available, support our common input interface, and provide broad coverage of recent model families and capacities. Full inference configurations are provided in Appendix G .

paragraphs.en: RQ1 examines how faithfully current I2V models realize causal cascades under different degrees of future-event specification. We first compare all nine models under Level 1 and then examine how performance changes under Levels 2 and 3. Finally, we apply post-hoc temporal alignment to assess how much of the remaining spatiotemporal discrepancy can be attributed to timing mismatch.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1 旨在探究当前 I2V 模型在不同程度的未来事件指定条件下，能够多忠实地实现因果级联。 我们首先在所有九种模型上对比 Level 1 的表现，然后考察性能在 Level 2 和 Level 3 下的变化。 最后，我们应用事后时间对齐方法，评估剩余时空差异中有多少可以归因于时间错位。

sents.en: RQ1 examines how faithfully current I2V models realize causal cascades under different degrees of future-event specification.
sents.zh: RQ1 旨在探究当前 I2V 模型在不同程度的未来事件指定条件下，能够多忠实地实现因果级联。

sents.en: We first compare all nine models under Level 1 and then examine how performance changes under Levels 2 and 3.
sents.zh: 我们首先在所有九种模型上对比 Level 1 的表现，然后考察性能在 Level 2 和 Level 3 下的变化。

sents.en: Finally, we apply post-hoc temporal alignment to assess how much of the remaining spatiotemporal discrepancy can be attributed to timing mismatch.
sents.zh: 最后，我们应用事后时间对齐方法，评估剩余时空差异中有多少可以归因于时间错位。

paragraphs.en: Finding 1: Spatial localization exceeds spatiotemporal agreement. Under the Level 1 setting, the model-average Spatial IoU reaches 0.194 0.194 , whereas Strict ST-IoU is only 0.043 0.043 (Figure 3 , left). Spatial IoU only asks whether motion appears in the relevant spatial regions, while Strict ST-IoU further requires the motion to occur at the corresponding physical time. Even the strongest model on both metrics, Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, reaches only 0.080 0.080 Strict ST-IoU despite a Spatial IoU of 0.312 0.312 . These results suggest that models can roughly anticipate where physical change should take place, but cannot faithfully realize how the corresponding interaction evolves over time.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 1：空间定位超过了时空一致性。 在一级设置下，模型平均的空间 IoU 达到 0.194 0.194，而严格 ST-IoU 仅为 0.043 0.043（图 3，左侧）。 空间 IoU 仅判断运动是否出现在相关的空间区域中，而严格 ST-IoU 还要求运动发生在对应的物理时间点上。 即使在两项指标上表现最强的模型 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，其严格 ST-IoU 也仅为 0.080 0.080，尽管其空间 IoU 达到了 0.312 0.312。 这些结果表明，模型能够大致预测物理变化应发生的位置，但无法忠实地实现相应交互随时间的演化过程。

sents.en: Finding 1: Spatial localization exceeds spatiotemporal agreement.
sents.zh: 发现 1：空间定位超过了时空一致性。

sents.en: Under the Level 1 setting, the model-average Spatial IoU reaches 0.194 0.194 , whereas Strict ST-IoU is only 0.043 0.043 (Figure 3 , left).

sents.en: These results suggest that models can roughly anticipate where physical change should take place, but cannot faithfully realize how the corresponding interaction evolves over time.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，模型能够大致预测物理变化应发生的位置，但无法忠实地实现相应交互随时间的演化过程。

paragraphs.en: Finding 2: Future-event specification helps event recovery, but physical realization remains limited. As future-event specification increases from Level 1 to Level 3, model-average VQA Overall rises from 0.193 0.193 to 0.325 0.325 , while Strict ST-IoU increases from 0.043 0.043 to 0.067 0.067 (Figure 3 , right). The same pattern appears for Wan2.2-I2V-A14B: VQA Overall rises from 0.252 0.252 to 0.532 0.532 , while Strict ST-IoU increases only from 0.080 0.080 to 0.131 0.131 . Thus, more explicit future-event specification reduces the difficulty of recovering what should happen, but event-level performance remains limited and faithfully realizing how the causal process unfolds remains difficult. The VQA dimensions further support the distinction that event occurrence is recovered more reliably than causal pathway, temporal ordering, and outcome or termination (Table 9 ). A representative case in Figure 4 illustrates the same pattern, while complete per-model quantitative results are reported in Appendix H .
paragraphs.zh: 发现 2：未来事件的具体描述有助于事件恢复，但物理实现仍然有限。 随着未来事件的具体描述从第 1 级提升至第 3 级，模型平均 VQA Overall 从 0.193 0.193 上升至 0.325 0.325，而 Strict ST-IoU 则从 0.043 0.043 增至 0.067 0.067（图 3，右侧）。 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 也呈现出相同趋势：VQA Overall 从 0.252 0.252 上升至 0.532 0.532，而 Strict ST-IoU 仅从 0.080 0.080 增至 0.131 0.131。 因此，更明确的未来事件描述降低了恢复“应发生何事”的难度，但事件层面的表现仍然有限，且忠实实现因果过程如何展开依然困难。 VQA 的各项维度进一步支持了以下区分：事件发生的恢复比因果路径、时间顺序以及结果或终止更为可靠（表 9）。 图 4 中的一个代表性案例说明了相同模式，而各模型的完整量化结果则报告在附录 H 中。

sents.zh: 发现 2：未来事件的具体描述有助于事件恢复，但物理实现仍然有限。

sents.en: The same pattern appears for Wan2.2-I2V-A14B: VQA Overall rises from 0.252 0.252 to 0.532 0.532 , while Strict ST-IoU increases only from 0.080 0.080 to 0.131 0.131 .

paragraphs.en: Finding 3: Temporal alignment explains only part of the remaining gap. Even under Level 3, model-average Strict ST-IoU remains only 0.067 0.067 . We therefore test whether the residual discrepancy can be explained by temporal misalignment. Global affine alignment corrects rollout-wide temporal shift and rate change, whereas constrained DTW additionally allows local stretching or compression while preserving the order. As shown in Figure 5 (top), Level 3 agreement increases to 0.086 0.086 after global alignment and 0.104 0.104 after constrained DTW, with similar gains under Levels 1 and 2. The representative case in Figure 5 (bottom) comes from a Wan2.2-I2V-A14B rollout of a stepped-domino cascade. The generated rollout exhibits both an overall timing mismatch and local replay of an earlier motion phase. Affine alignment captures the broad temporal shift and rate mismatch, whereas constrained DTW can additionally follow local timing variations. The remaining mismatch shows that flexible temporal alignment can recover correspondence between some motion phases without restoring the correct physical progression of the cascade. Detailed formulations and alignment constraints are in Appendix E.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 发现 3：时间对齐仅能解释剩余差距的一部分。 即使在第 3 级下，模型平均的严格 ST-IoU 仍仅为 0.067 0.067。 因此，我们检验剩余差异是否可由时间错位所解释。 全局仿射对齐可校正整个展开过程中的时间偏移和速率变化，而受限 DTW 在保持顺序的同时，还允许局部拉伸或压缩。 如图 5（顶部）所示，经过全局对齐后，第 3 级的一致性提升至 0.086 0.086，经受限 DTW 对齐后则达到 0.104 0.104；在第 1 级和第 2 级下也获得了类似的提升。 图 5（底部）中的代表性案例来自一个阶梯式多米诺级联结构的 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 展开过程。 生成的展开过程既表现出整体时间同步问题，也出现了早期运动阶段的局部重播现象。 仿射对齐能够捕捉到整体的时间偏移和速率不匹配，而受限 DTW 则能进一步追踪局部的时间变化。 剩余的不匹配表明，灵活的时间对齐虽能恢复某些运动阶段之间的对应关系，却无法重建级联结构正确的物理演化顺序。 详细的公式表述和对齐约束见附录 E.5。

sents.en: Finding 3: Temporal alignment explains only part of the remaining gap.
sents.zh: 发现 3：时间对齐仅能解释剩余差距的一部分。

sents.en: Even under Level 3, model-average Strict ST-IoU remains only 0.067 0.067 .
sents.zh: 即使在第 3 级下，模型平均的严格 ST-IoU 仍仅为 0.067 0.067。

sents.zh: 因此，我们检验剩余差异是否可由时间错位所解释。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 5 (top), Level 3 agreement increases to 0.086 0.086 after global alignment and 0.104 0.104 after constrained DTW, with similar gains under Levels 1 and 2.
sents.zh: 如图 5（顶部）所示，经过全局对齐后，第 3 级的一致性提升至 0.086 0.086，经受限 DTW 对齐后则达到 0.104 0.104；在第 1 级和第 2 级下也获得了类似的提升。

sents.en: The representative case in Figure 5 (bottom) comes from a Wan2.2-I2V-A14B rollout of a stepped-domino cascade.
sents.zh: 图 5（底部）中的代表性案例来自一个阶梯式多米诺级联结构的 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 展开过程。

sents.zh: 生成的展开过程既表现出整体时间同步问题，也出现了早期运动阶段的局部重播现象。

sents.en: Affine alignment captures the broad temporal shift and rate mismatch, whereas constrained DTW can additionally follow local timing variations.
sents.zh: 仿射对齐能够捕捉到整体的时间偏移和速率不匹配，而受限 DTW 则能进一步追踪局部的时间变化。

sents.zh: 剩余的不匹配表明，灵活的时间对齐虽能恢复某些运动阶段之间的对应关系，却无法重建级联结构正确的物理演化顺序。

sents.en: Detailed formulations and alignment constraints are in Appendix E.5 .
sents.zh: 详细的公式表述和对齐约束见附录 E.5。

paragraphs.en: Overall, future-event specification improves recovery of what should happen, while temporal alignment explains some mismatch in when it happens. Yet neither closes the gap in faithfully realizing how the causal cascade unfolds.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，未来事件规范能够提升对“应发生何事”的恢复能力，而时间对齐则能解释“何时发生”方面的一些不匹配。 然而，这两种方法都无法弥合在忠实实现因果级联如何展开方面的差距。

paragraphs.en: Using the counterfactual evaluation protocol defined in Section 4.4 , RQ2 examines whether current I2V models selectively update their generated futures under controlled physical interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 根据第 4.4 节中定义的反事实评估协议，研究问题 2（RQ2）旨在探究当前的图像到视频（I2V）模型是否在受控的物理干预下，会选择性地更新其生成的未来状态。

paragraphs.en: Finding 4: Models struggle to realize the consequences of interventions. Figure 6 plots CF Spatial Effect IoU against CF Preserve Spatial IoU for all nine models. Across the four types, models remain low in Effect performance, indicating that they rarely respond to changes in the physical state by producing the corresponding pattern of suppressed and induced motion. Inspection of complete factual-counterfactual rollouts reveals recurring manifestations of this behavior, including pairs that evolve nearly identically despite a consequential intervention and pairs that change but not according to the reference consequence. Representative cases are analyzed in Appendix I.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 发现 4：模型难以认识到干预措施所带来的后果。 图 6 展示了所有九个模型中 CF 空间效应 IoU 与 CF 空间保留 IoU 的关系。 在这四种类型中，模型在“效应”方面的表现仍然较低，表明它们很少通过生成受抑制和受诱导运动的对应模式来对物理状态的变化作出响应。 对完整的真实-反事实展开过程的检查揭示了这种行为反复出现的表现形式，包括尽管存在关键性干预措施却几乎以相同方式演化的成对情况，以及虽然发生变化但未按照参考后果演化的成对情况。 代表性案例在附录 I.1 中进行了分析。

sents.en: Finding 4: Models struggle to realize the consequences of interventions.
sents.zh: 发现 4：模型难以认识到干预措施所带来的后果。

sents.en: Figure 6 plots CF Spatial Effect IoU against CF Preserve Spatial IoU for all nine models.
sents.zh: 图 6 展示了所有九个模型中 CF 空间效应 IoU 与 CF 空间保留 IoU 的关系。

sents.en: Across the four types, models remain low in Effect performance, indicating that they rarely respond to changes in the physical state by producing the corresponding pattern of suppressed and induced motion.
sents.zh: 在这四种类型中，模型在“效应”方面的表现仍然较低，表明它们很少通过生成受抑制和受诱导运动的对应模式来对物理状态的变化作出响应。

sents.en: Inspection of complete factual-counterfactual rollouts reveals recurring manifestations of this behavior, including pairs that evolve nearly identically despite a consequential intervention and pairs that change but not according to the reference consequence.
sents.zh: 对完整的真实-反事实展开过程的检查揭示了这种行为反复出现的表现形式，包括尽管存在关键性干预措施却几乎以相同方式演化的成对情况，以及虽然发生变化但未按照参考后果演化的成对情况。

sents.en: Representative cases are analyzed in Appendix I.1 .
sents.zh: 代表性案例在附录 I.1 中进行了分析。

paragraphs.en: Finding 5: Intervention responses are not sufficiently selective. Preserve performance is also limited across all four intervention types, with the highest CF Preserve Spatial IoUs remaining around 0.25 0.25 – 0.30 0.30 . Thus, even when models respond to an intervention, they often fail to confine the response to the affected dynamics while preserving motion shared by the reference pair. The case studies in Appendix I.2 further illustrate responses that disturb dynamics which should remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 问题 5：干预响应缺乏足够的选择性。 在所有四种干预类型中，性能保持能力也有限，其中最高的 CF Preserve Spatial IoU 仅在 0.25–0.30 左右。 因此，即使模型对干预作出响应，它们通常也无法将响应限制在受影响的动态上，同时保留参考对共有的运动。 附录 I.2 中的案例研究进一步说明了那些干扰了本应保持不变的动力学的响应。

sents.en: Finding 5: Intervention responses are not sufficiently selective.
sents.zh: 问题 5：干预响应缺乏足够的选择性。

sents.en: Preserve performance is also limited across all four intervention types, with the highest CF Preserve Spatial IoUs remaining around 0.25 0.25 – 0.30 0.30 .
sents.zh: 在所有四种干预类型中，性能保持能力也有限，其中最高的 CF Preserve Spatial IoU 仅在 0.25–0.30 左右。

sents.en: Thus, even when models respond to an intervention, they often fail to confine the response to the affected dynamics while preserving motion shared by the reference pair.
sents.zh: 因此，即使模型对干预作出响应，它们通常也无法将响应限制在受影响的动态上，同时保留参考对共有的运动。

sents.en: The case studies in Appendix I.2 further illustrate responses that disturb dynamics which should remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 附录 I.2 中的案例研究进一步说明了那些干扰了本应保持不变的动力学的响应。

paragraphs.en: Weighted-spatial metrics exhibit the same pattern; complete results are reported in Appendix H.3 . Collectively, current I2V models do not yet reliably update a generated future in accordance with interventions to the underlying physical state.
paragraphs.zh: 加权空间指标也呈现出相同的模式；完整结果见附录 H.3。 总体而言，当前的 I2V 模型尚无法根据对底层物理状态的干预可靠地更新生成的未来状态。

sents.en: Weighted-spatial metrics exhibit the same pattern; complete results are reported in Appendix H.3 .
sents.zh: 加权空间指标也呈现出相同的模式；完整结果见附录 H.3。

sents.en: Collectively, current I2V models do not yet reliably update a generated future in accordance with interventions to the underlying physical state.
sents.zh: 总体而言，当前的 I2V 模型尚无法根据对底层物理状态的干预可靠地更新生成的未来状态。

paragraphs.en: Dimension-level VQA results already reveal uneven weaknesses across the causal process: scene consistency is relatively stronger, while event occurrence remains limited and causal pathway, temporal ordering, and outcome or termination are substantially lower (Table 9 ). However, these aggregate scores do not reveal where an individual rollout first departs from the reference process or how the resulting failures manifest. We therefore combine structured failure localization on a fixed audit subset with broader qualitative case analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 维度级别的 VQA 结果已经揭示了因果过程中各阶段的失衡弱点：场景一致性相对较强，而事件发生仍然有限，因果路径、时间顺序以及结果或终止则明显更低（表 9）。 然而，这些汇总分数并未揭示单个展开过程在何处首次偏离参考流程，也未说明由此产生的失败具体以何种形式表现。 因此，我们将对固定审计子集的结构化失败定位与更广泛的定性案例分析相结合。

paragraphs.en: Finding 6: Most audited failures are foundational. For quantitative failure localization, we audit a fixed scene-level subset of 90 rollouts with matched scene-prompt coverage across all nine models, without selecting cases based on individual model success or failure. We group scene consistency and event occurrence as foundational failures , and causal pathway, temporal ordering, and outcome or termination as process failures . As shown in Figure 7 , 84.4% of earliest failures are foundational, while only 15.6% first occur at the later process dimensions. Thus, the dominant bottleneck lies in establishing a persistent physical world and its event-level foundations before stable causal propagation can be sustained. Detailed subset construction and annotation protocols are provided in Appendix J .
paragraphs.zh: 发现 6：大多数经过审计的失败都是基础性的。 为了进行定量失败定位，我们对 90 次展开中一个固定的场景级子集进行了审计，该子集覆盖了所有九个模型匹配的场景提示，且未根据单个模型的成功或失败来选择案例。 我们将场景一致性和事件发生归为基础性失败，而将因果路径、时间顺序以及结果或终止归为过程性失败。 如图 7 所示，最早出现的失败中 84.4% 是基础性的，而仅有 15.6% 的失败首次出现在后续的过程维度上。 因此，主要瓶颈在于在稳定的因果传播得以维持之前，先建立一个持久的物理世界及其事件级基础。 详细的子集构建和标注协议见附录 J。

paragraphs.en: Finding 7: Early deviations can reshape the downstream causal process. Broader qualitative inspection across the benchmark shows that once a rollout departs from the reference process, the resulting error need not remain local. Figure 8 provides representative examples of such departures. Across these cases, an early deviation in the scene state or event process can change the conditions from which subsequent interactions unfold, causing later events to be omitted, misrouted, replayed, or otherwise deviate from the reference cascade. These cases show that partial success does not guarantee sustained causal coherence: a local deviation can alter how later events unfold or whether the cascade remains physically consistent. Detailed multilabel and downstream consequence analyses on the audited subset are provided in Appendix J.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 发现 7：早期的偏离可能重塑下游的因果过程。 对基准数据集进行的更广泛的定性检查表明，一旦一次展开偏离了参考过程，由此产生的错误未必会局限于局部范围。 图 8 提供了此类偏离的代表性示例。 在这些案例中，场景状态或事件过程的早期偏离可能改变后续互动发生的前提条件，导致后来的事件被遗漏、路径错误、重复播放或以其他方式偏离参考级联过程。 这些案例表明，部分成功并不保证因果连贯性的持续存在：局部偏离可能改变后续事件的发生方式，或影响级联过程是否保持物理一致性。 经审计子集上的详细多标签及下游后果分析见附录 J.4。

paragraphs.en: We introduced CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark for evaluating causal cascade generation as a process-level capability of I2V models. By combining structured event graphs, controlled future-event specification, physical interventions, and complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics, CausalCascade examines three aspects of this capability: faithful realization of causal processes, selective responsiveness to changes in the physical world, and localization of where those processes break.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CausalCascade，这是一个基于模拟器的基准测试，用于评估因果级联生成作为 I2V 模型过程层面能力的表现。 通过结合结构化事件图、受控的未来事件指定、物理干预，以及互补的运动、事件和反事实层面的诊断方法，CausalCascade 检验了这项能力的三个维度：对因果过程的忠实实现、对物理世界变化的选择性响应，以及这些过程失效位置的定位。

sents.en: We introduced CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark for evaluating causal cascade generation as a process-level capability of I2V models.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 CausalCascade，这是一个基于模拟器的基准测试，用于评估因果级联生成作为 I2V 模型过程层面能力的表现。

sents.en: By combining structured event graphs, controlled future-event specification, physical interventions, and complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics, CausalCascade examines three aspects of this capability: faithful realization of causal processes, selective responsiveness to changes in the physical world, and localization of where those processes break.
sents.zh: 通过结合结构化事件图、受控的未来事件指定、物理干预，以及互补的运动、事件和反事实层面的诊断方法，CausalCascade 检验了这项能力的三个维度：对因果过程的忠实实现、对物理世界变化的选择性响应，以及这些过程失效位置的定位。

paragraphs.en: Across nine I2V models, we find that generated motion is more reliably localized spatially than realized with faithful spatiotemporal evolution, while richer future-event specification improves event recovery but leaves physical realization limited. Counterfactual evaluation further shows that intervention responses are weakly selective: models struggle both to realize affected dynamics and to preserve those that should remain unchanged. Finally, most audited earliest failures arise at foundational scene-consistency or event-occurrence stages, indicating that sustained causal propagation often breaks before later causal dependencies can be faithfully realized. Together, these findings show that causal video generation requires more than producing plausible events: models must maintain a coherent physical world, realize how causal effects unfold over time, and selectively propagate the consequences of physical changes. We hope that CausalCascade provides a useful testbed for measuring progress toward video-based world models with these capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 在九种 I2V 模型中，我们发现生成的运动在空间定位上的可靠性高于通过忠实时空演化实现的运动；而更丰富的未来事件描述虽然能提升事件恢复能力，却使物理实现受到限制。 反事实评估进一步表明，干预响应的选择性较弱：模型既难以实现受影响的动态变化，也难以保留那些本应保持不变的部分。 最后，经审计的大多数早期失败都出现在基础场景一致性或事件发生阶段，这表明持续的因果传播往往在后续因果依赖关系被忠实实现之前就已中断。 综合来看，这些发现表明，因果视频生成不仅需要生成看似合理的事件，模型还必须维持一个连贯的物理世界，实现因果效应随时间的展开过程，并有选择地传播物理变化所带来的后果。 我们希望 CausalCascade 能为衡量基于视频的世界模型在这些能力上的进展提供一个有用的测试平台。

paragraphs.en: We construct 50 event-rich base scenes in Blender 5.0, comprising 954 rigid-body instances in total. The scenes are designed around multi-stage physical processes rather than isolated interactions and also contain causally consequential scene factors, such that interventions on selected objects can alter downstream interactions and outcomes, enabling meaningful controlled counterfactual evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Blender 5.0 中构建了 50 个富含事件的基础场景，总共包含 954 个刚体实例。 这些场景围绕多阶段物理过程而非孤立互动进行设计，并且还包含了具有因果关联的场景因素，因此对选定物体进行干预可以改变下游的互动与结果，从而实现有意义的受控反事实评估。

sents.en: We construct 50 event-rich base scenes in Blender 5.0, comprising 954 rigid-body instances in total.
sents.zh: 我们在 Blender 5.0 中构建了 50 个富含事件的基础场景，总共包含 954 个刚体实例。

sents.en: The scenes are designed around multi-stage physical processes rather than isolated interactions and also contain causally consequential scene factors, such that interventions on selected objects can alter downstream interactions and outcomes, enabling meaningful controlled counterfactual evaluation.
sents.zh: 这些场景围绕多阶段物理过程而非孤立互动进行设计，并且还包含了具有因果关联的场景因素，因此对选定物体进行干预可以改变下游的互动与结果，从而实现有意义的受控反事实评估。

paragraphs.en: To retain precise control over geometry and physical behavior, all dynamic objects and core mechanical components are constructed from simple geometric primitives in Blender, including cubes, spheres, cylinders, and meshes derived from these primitives. More complex mechanisms are assembled from combinations of these primitives; for example, a seesaw consists of a rectangular plank, a triangular support, and a hinge constraint. We assume uniform object density and set the center of mass of each rigid body to its geometric center to reduce ambiguities introduced by irregular asset geometry or uncertain mass distributions. External 3D assets are used only occasionally as decorative context to increase visual complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对几何形状和物理行为保持精确控制，所有动态物体和核心机械部件都在 Blender 中由简单的几何基本体构建而成，包括立方体、球体、圆柱体以及由这些基本体派生出的网格。 更复杂的机制则由这些基本体的组合组装而成；例如，一个跷跷板由一块矩形木板、一个三角形支撑和一个铰链约束组成。 我们假设物体密度均匀，并将每个刚体的质心设置为其几何中心，以减少不规则资产几何形状或不确定的质量分布所引入的歧义。 外部 3D 资产仅偶尔用作装饰性背景，以增加视觉复杂性。

sents.en: To retain precise control over geometry and physical behavior, all dynamic objects and core mechanical components are constructed from simple geometric primitives in Blender, including cubes, spheres, cylinders, and meshes derived from these primitives.
sents.zh: 为了对几何形状和物理行为保持精确控制，所有动态物体和核心机械部件都在 Blender 中由简单的几何基本体构建而成，包括立方体、球体、圆柱体以及由这些基本体派生出的网格。

sents.en: More complex mechanisms are assembled from combinations of these primitives; for example, a seesaw consists of a rectangular plank, a triangular support, and a hinge constraint.
sents.zh: 更复杂的机制则由这些基本体的组合组装而成；例如，一个跷跷板由一块矩形木板、一个三角形支撑和一个铰链约束组成。

sents.en: We assume uniform object density and set the center of mass of each rigid body to its geometric center to reduce ambiguities introduced by irregular asset geometry or uncertain mass distributions.
sents.zh: 我们假设物体密度均匀，并将每个刚体的质心设置为其几何中心，以减少不规则资产几何形状或不确定的质量分布所引入的歧义。

sents.en: External 3D assets are used only occasionally as decorative context to increase visual complexity.
sents.zh: 外部 3D 资产仅偶尔用作装饰性背景，以增加视觉复杂性。

paragraphs.en: Building on the primitives, we construct scene-specific instances of several recurring physical interaction motifs. We select these motifs because they pose challenges for causal dynamics generation. Interaction-rich motifs, such as domino chains and Galton boards, involve dense sequences of contacts and collisions that are challenging to predict and track; instability-driven motifs, such as unbalanced seesaws and unstable structures, require reasoning about support relations or mass distribution from the initial configuration before predicting the subsequent evolution. These motifs serve as high-level organizational patterns rather than fixed scene templates. For each scene, we adapt their geometry, topology, scale, and object arrangement to produce a distinct instance. For example, a conventional linear domino chain may be transformed into an S-shaped, L-shaped, or Y-shaped branching configuration, while a seesaw may use an off-center fulcrum or more complex object arrangements on its two sides.
paragraphs.zh: 在基础元素之上，我们构建出针对特定场景的多个重复出现的物理交互模式的具体实例。 我们选择这些模式，是因为它们对因果动力学生成构成了挑战。 交互丰富的模式（如多米诺骨牌链和加尔顿板）涉及密集的一系列接触与碰撞，难以预测和追踪；而由不稳定性驱动的模式（如不平衡的跷跷板和不稳定结构）则需要根据初始配置推理支撑关系或质量分布，才能预测其后续演化。 这些模式是高层次的组织模式，而非固定的场景模板。 对于每个场景，我们都会调整它们的几何形状、拓扑结构、规模和物体布局，以生成独特的实例。 例如，传统的线性多米诺骨牌链可以转化为 S 形、L 形或 Y 形的分支结构；而跷跷板则可以使用偏离中心的支点，或在两侧采用更复杂的物体排列方式。

sents.zh: 在基础元素之上，我们构建出针对特定场景的多个重复出现的物理交互模式的具体实例。

sents.en: We select these motifs because they pose challenges for causal dynamics generation.

sents.en: These motifs serve as high-level organizational patterns rather than fixed scene templates.

sents.en: For each scene, we adapt their geometry, topology, scale, and object arrangement to produce a distinct instance.
sents.zh: 对于每个场景，我们都会调整它们的几何形状、拓扑结构、规模和物体布局，以生成独特的实例。

sents.en: For example, a conventional linear domino chain may be transformed into an S-shaped, L-shaped, or Y-shaped branching configuration, while a seesaw may use an off-center fulcrum or more complex object arrangements on its two sides.
sents.zh: 例如，传统的线性多米诺骨牌链可以转化为 S 形、L 形或 Y 形的分支结构；而跷跷板则可以使用偏离中心的支点，或在两侧采用更复杂的物体排列方式。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 9 , the construction process comprises four stages. Each scene is constructed around such motif instances, which serve as the core interaction pattern of the scene. First, we establish a supporting environment, typically a tabletop or ground plane, and construct the selected motif instance from primitive-based components. Second, we optionally introduce upstream and downstream objects to extend the interaction beyond the core motif. Upstream objects provide the initiating condition, such as a ball rolling down a ramp and striking the first domino, whereas downstream objects transform the output of the motif into further collisions, falls, or other mechanical responses. We may also add a small number of stationary decorative objects to increase visual complexity. Third, we assign physical roles to all scene entities, distinguishing active rigid bodies from anchored passive supports and decorative objects. Finally, we assign PBR materials and HDRI environments selected from Poly Haven and position a fixed camera such that the causally relevant objects and their anticipated motion paths remain visible with minimal occlusion throughout the rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 9 所示，构建过程包含四个阶段。 每个场景都围绕此类母题实例进行构建，这些实例构成了场景的核心交互模式。 首先，我们建立一个支撑环境（通常是桌面或地面平面），并用基于原语的基本组件构建选定的母题实例。 其次，我们可以选择引入上游和下游物体，使交互超越核心母题的范围。 上游物体提供触发条件，例如一个球体沿斜坡滚落并撞击第一块多米诺骨牌；而下游物体则会将母题的输出转化为进一步的碰撞、坠落或其他机械响应。 我们还可以添加少量静止的装饰性物体，以增加视觉复杂度。 第三，我们为场景中的所有实体分配物理角色，区分主动刚体与固定不动的被动支撑物及装饰性物体。 最后，我们从 Poly Haven 中挑选 PBR 材质和 HDRI 环境，并固定一个摄像头的位置，确保在整个演化过程中，具有因果关联的物体及其预期的运动轨迹始终可见且遮挡最小。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 9 , the construction process comprises four stages.
sents.zh: 如图 9 所示，构建过程包含四个阶段。

sents.en: Each scene is constructed around such motif instances, which serve as the core interaction pattern of the scene.
sents.zh: 每个场景都围绕此类母题实例进行构建，这些实例构成了场景的核心交互模式。

sents.en: First, we establish a supporting environment, typically a tabletop or ground plane, and construct the selected motif instance from primitive-based components.
sents.zh: 首先，我们建立一个支撑环境（通常是桌面或地面平面），并用基于原语的基本组件构建选定的母题实例。

sents.en: Second, we optionally introduce upstream and downstream objects to extend the interaction beyond the core motif.
sents.zh: 其次，我们可以选择引入上游和下游物体，使交互超越核心母题的范围。

sents.en: Upstream objects provide the initiating condition, such as a ball rolling down a ramp and striking the first domino, whereas downstream objects transform the output of the motif into further collisions, falls, or other mechanical responses.
sents.zh: 上游物体提供触发条件，例如一个球体沿斜坡滚落并撞击第一块多米诺骨牌；而下游物体则会将母题的输出转化为进一步的碰撞、坠落或其他机械响应。

sents.en: We may also add a small number of stationary decorative objects to increase visual complexity.
sents.zh: 我们还可以添加少量静止的装饰性物体，以增加视觉复杂度。

sents.en: Third, we assign physical roles to all scene entities, distinguishing active rigid bodies from anchored passive supports and decorative objects.
sents.zh: 第三，我们为场景中的所有实体分配物理角色，区分主动刚体与固定不动的被动支撑物及装饰性物体。

sents.en: Finally, we assign PBR materials and HDRI environments selected from Poly Haven and position a fixed camera such that the causally relevant objects and their anticipated motion paths remain visible with minimal occlusion throughout the rollout.
sents.zh: 最后，我们从 Poly Haven 中挑选 PBR 材质和 HDRI 环境，并固定一个摄像头的位置，确保在整个演化过程中，具有因果关联的物体及其预期的运动轨迹始终可见且遮挡最小。

paragraphs.en: After scene construction, we run the rigid-body simulation and render the resulting rollout at 24 frames per second. The rollout length is determined separately for each scene to ensure that all interactions have occurred and the objects have reached a stable state. We render each video at a resolution of 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 using Eevee. For every base scene, we export the initial RGB frame I 0 I_{0} , the complete ground-truth rollout V ∗ V^{*} , and structured metadata describing the scene entities and their physical properties.
paragraphs.zh: 场景构建完成后，我们运行刚体模拟，并以每秒 24 帧的速率渲染生成的模拟过程。 每个场景的模拟时长均单独确定，以确保所有相互作用均已发生，且物体已达到稳定状态。 我们使用 Eevee 以 1920 × 1080 的分辨率渲染每段视频。 对于每个基础场景，我们都会导出初始 RGB 帧 I₀、完整的真实模拟过程 V*，以及描述场景中实体及其物理属性的结构化元数据。

paragraphs.en: Each graph additionally contains a participant registry that associates visually grounded entity descriptions with simulator metadata. A participant stores a stable graph-local identifier, canonical name, corresponding Blender metadata keys, participant type, and a visual referring expression. Repeated structures such as domino chains, peg arrays, and stacks are represented at the group level whenever their members share the same physical role. Individual members are separated only when they play a distinct causal role, such as an initiating domino, terminal target, or critical support. This keeps event granularity consistent across scenes with different numbers of repeated objects.
paragraphs.zh: 每个图还包含一个参与者注册表，用于将基于视觉的实体描述与模拟器的元数据关联起来。 一个参与者会存储一个稳定的图内标识符、规范名称、对应的 Blender 元数据键、参与者类型以及一个视觉指代表达式。 当重复结构（如多米诺骨牌链、销钉阵列和堆叠）的成员具有相同的物理角色时，这些结构将在组级别进行表示。 只有当成员扮演不同的因果角色时，它们才会被单独区分，例如作为起始多米诺骨牌、终端目标或关键支撑。 这样可以在不同重复对象数量的场景中保持事件颗粒度的一致性。

paragraphs.en: An event is included only if it is visually observable from the RGB sequence, sufficiently atomic to be independently verified, relevant to the main causal cascade, diagnostically informative, and represented at a granularity consistent with other scenes. Event types include motion onset, contact/collision, support loss, tipping or rotation, falling, sliding, rolling, propagation, target-state change, and stabilization. Each event is assigned one of four cascade roles: trigger , mediator , outcome , or terminal_state . Minor unrelated motion, repeated contacts, background variation, and changes that do not affect the principal cascade are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当某个事件可以通过 RGB 序列进行视觉观察、足够原子化以独立验证、与主要因果链相关、具有诊断信息价值，并且其表示的粒度与其他场景一致时，才会被纳入。 事件类型包括运动开始、接触/碰撞、支撑丧失、倾倒或旋转、坠落、滑动、滚动、传播、目标状态变化以及稳定化。 每个事件都会被分配四个因果链角色之一：触发者、中介者、结果或终端状态。 无关的次要运动、重复接触、背景变化以及不影响主要因果链的变化均被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: For each base scene, we load the Blender scene metadata, initial rendered frame, and complete simulator-rendered frame sequence. We sample every 10th frame and additionally include the final frame when it is not selected by the regular stride, arranging the sampled frames chronologically into review contact sheets. A multimodal language-model gpt-5.4-pro API receives these visual summaries together with the annotation criteria defined above and produces an intermediate structured scene specification. Each specification is then manually reviewed against the simulator-derived reference rollout and scene metadata, with event descriptions, participant assignments, temporal stages, cascade roles, and direct causal dependencies corrected where necessary. Only the reviewed specification is deterministically converted into the final event_graph.json .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个基础场景，我们会加载 Blender 场景元数据、初始渲染帧以及完整的模拟器渲染帧序列。 我们以每 10 帧为间隔进行采样，并在常规采样步长未选中的情况下额外包含最后一帧，然后将这些采样帧按时间顺序排列成审查接触表。 一个多模态语言模型 gpt-5.4-pro API 会接收这些视觉摘要以及上文定义的标注标准，并生成一个中间结构化的场景规范。 随后，每个规范都会与源自模拟器的参考运行轨迹和场景元数据进行人工核对，必要时修正事件描述、参与者分配、时间阶段、级联角色和直接因果依赖关系。 只有经过审核的规范才会被确定性地转换为最终的 event_graph.json 文件。

paragraphs.en: Exported graphs are automatically checked for unique event identifiers, valid participant and edge references, required event fields, temporal consistency, duplicate edges, directed cycles, unsupported relation types, and redundant transitive edges. Across the 50 base scenes, the resulting graphs contain 267 event nodes and 226 direct causal edges. The nodes comprise 58 triggers, 94 mediators, 65 outcomes, and one terminal-state event for each of the 50 scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 导出的图会自动检查唯一事件标识符、有效的参与者和边引用、必需的事件字段、时间一致性、重复边、有向环、不支持的关系类型以及冗余的传递边。 在 50 个基础场景中，生成的图包含 267 个事件节点和 226 条直接因果边。 这些节点包括 58 个触发器、94 个中介者、65 个结果，以及每个场景中的一个终端状态事件。

paragraphs.en: Diagnostic questions are deterministically generated from the annotated event nodes, causal edges, temporal stages, and participant registry using fixed templates. Each question retains provenance information linking it to its source events, edges, stages, and participants. All questions use closed answer spaces, enabling deterministic scoring and direct attribution of errors to specific aspects of the causal cascade.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断性问题通过固定模板，从已标注的事件节点、因果边、时间阶段和参与者登记表中确定性地生成。 每个问题都保留其来源事件、边、阶段和参与者的溯源信息。 所有问题均采用封闭答案空间，从而实现确定性评分，并将错误直接归因于因果级联的特定方面。

paragraphs.en: For every trigger and mediator event, we generate a binary question asking whether the event occurs in the evaluated video. This dimension tests whether the cascade is initiated correctly and whether intermediate propagation stages are realized. Outcomes are evaluated separately below.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个触发器和中介事件，我们都会生成一个二元问题，询问该事件是否在正在评估的视频中出现。 这个维度用于检验级联是否被正确启动，以及中间传播阶段是否得以实现。 结果将在下方单独进行评估。

paragraphs.en: A and B occur approximately simultaneously;

paragraphs.en: The final option prevents the evaluator from assigning a temporal relation when one of the required events is absent. For simple graphs we retain all eligible pairs; for more complex graphs we sample up to approximately six pairs distributed across early, middle, and late portions of the cascade.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate up to three principal downstream outcomes per scene with binary occurrence questions. Each scene additionally contains one terminal-state question with three possible answers: the reference final state is reached and remains terminal; it is reached but subsequent motion violates terminality; or it is not reached. This distinguishes correct completion from both premature failure and continued dynamics after an otherwise correct outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个场景最多评估三个主要下游结果，并使用二元发生问题进行分析。 此外，每个场景还包含一个终端状态问题，有三个可能的答案：达到了参考最终状态并保持终端状态；虽然达到了该状态，但后续动作违反了终端性；或者未能达到该状态。 这有助于将正确完成与过早失败以及在原本正确的结果之后持续发生动态变化的情况区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Each scene contains four complementary consistency questions. Entity persistence detects unexplained disappearance or duplication while allowing normal motion out of view. Trajectory continuity detects teleportation or repeated spatial discontinuities while allowing temporary occlusion. Identity and geometry integrity detects persistent identity changes, rigid-body deformation, fragmentation, or fusion while allowing ordinary viewpoint and illumination variation. Static-scene and camera stability checks that anchored structures and the fixed camera remain stable, while permitting objects explicitly marked as dynamic to move.
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景都包含四个相互补充的一致性检验问题。 实体持续性检测会识别无法解释的消失或重复，但允许实体正常移出画面。 轨迹连续性检测会识别瞬移或反复出现的位置不连续，但允许暂时遮挡。 身份与几何完整性检测会识别持续的身份变化、刚体形变、碎片化或融合，但允许正常的视角和光照变化。 静态场景与相机稳定性检验确保固定结构和固定相机保持稳定，同时允许明确标记为动态的物体移动。

paragraphs.en: For temporal-order and causal-pathway questions, the presentation order of events A and B is deterministically chosen from a SHA-256 hash of the scene identifier, edge identifier, and question type. This prevents the correct relation from being systematically associated with a fixed answer position while remaining fully reproducible. Among the temporal-order questions, 50.3% have A-before-B as the ground-truth relation, 40.2% have B-before-A, and 9.5% describe approximately simultaneous events. And among the causal-pathway questions, the two causal directions account for 44.2% and 55.8%, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 对于时间顺序和因果路径问题，事件 A 和 B 的呈现顺序是根据场景标识符、边标识符和问题类型的 SHA-256 哈希值确定性地选择的。 这既能防止正确关系与固定的答案位置产生系统性关联，又能确保结果完全可重复。 在时间顺序问题中，50.3% 的正确答案是 A 先于 B，40.2% 是 B 先于 A，另有 9.5% 描述的事件大致同时发生。 而在因果路径问题中，两种因果方向分别占 44.2% 和 55.8%。

paragraphs.en: Within each session, the judge can adaptively query the evidence tools summarized in Table 3 . The interface separates direct visual inspection from computational diagnostics: observe provides global temporal context; zoom , temporal_pair , and paired_zoom resolve event boundaries and permit focused within- or across-rollout comparison; flow_info and segments localize periods of activity; and tracks , align , and traj_diff provide coarse object-motion and cross-rollout trajectory evidence. The image-based tools supply the primary semantic evidence, whereas the motion and tracking diagnostics guide attention and test candidate interpretations without determining the answer themselves. Every result is returned to the same session, allowing the judge to refine subsequent spatial crops or temporal windows in response to the evidence already observed.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个会话中，裁判都可以自适应地查询表3中总结的证据工具。 该界面将直接视觉检查与计算诊断分离开来：observe 提供全局时间上下文；zoom、temporal_pair 和 paired_zoom 可确定事件边界，并支持在单个部署或跨部署范围内进行聚焦比较；flow_info 和 segments 可定位活动时段；而 tracks、align 和 traj_diff 则提供粗略的对象运动及跨部署轨迹证据。 基于图像的工具提供主要语义证据，而运动和追踪诊断则用于引导注意力并检验候选解释，但本身并不直接确定答案。 所有结果都会返回到同一会话中，使裁判能够根据已观察到的证据，进一步调整后续的空间裁剪或时间窗口。

paragraphs.en: The system prompt defines a literal event-verification policy. It specifies that every named participant, initial condition, direction, contact or support relation, repetition count, and endpoint is a required part of an event. The reference rollout may be used to identify the intended participant and relation, but cannot be copied as the verdict for the generated rollout. The prompt also distinguishes direct causation from temporal precedence, normal exit through an image boundary from disappearance, foreground motion from camera motion, and a briefly reached outcome from a terminal state that remains stable.
paragraphs.zh: 系统提示定义了一项字面化的事件验证策略。 它规定，每个命名的参与者、初始条件、方向、接触或支持关系、重复次数以及终点都是事件的必要组成部分。 参考展开可用于识别预期的参与者和关系，但不可直接复制作为生成展开的判定结果。 该提示还区分了直接因果与时间先后、通过图像边界的正常退出与消失、前景运动与相机运动，以及短暂达成的结果与保持稳定的终端状态。

paragraphs.en: Scene-consistency judgments are particularly susceptible to misinterpretation by vision-language models because they require tracking subtle object-level changes over time. Small or repeated objects, temporary occlusion, appearance variation, and foreground motion can lead a semantic judge to report spurious duplication, disappearance, identity change, or camera movement. We therefore use a deterministic object-centric branch that grounds the four subdimensions in object lifecycle, mask geometry, camera-compensated trajectories, and background stability. This design makes each prediction temporally localized and auditable while applying consistent criteria across models and prompt levels.
paragraphs.zh: 场景一致性判断尤其容易受到视觉语言模型误判的影响，因为这类判断需要追踪物体层面随时间发生的细微变化。 微小或重复出现的物体、临时遮挡、外观变化以及前景运动，都可能导致语义判断器报告虚假的重复、消失、身份变更或相机移动。 因此，我们采用了一个确定性的以物体为中心的分支，将四个子维度锚定在物体的生命周期、掩码几何结构、经相机补偿后的轨迹以及背景稳定性上。 这种设计使每个预测都具有时间上的局部性和可追溯性，同时确保不同模型和提示层级之间应用一致的标准。

paragraphs.en: The branch evaluates entity persistence and identity/geometry at nine uniformly spaced frames, trajectory continuity at 13 frames, and static-scene/camera stability over the complete rollout downsampled to 0.20 × 0.20\times resolution. Entity persistence retains at most 16 initial objects and enables sparse re-detection; identity/geometry retains at most 12; trajectory retains at most six objects selected by activity in the simulator reference. Reference activity is used only to prioritize initial participants and never supplies the generated-video answer. After establishing object identities, the pipeline records their temporal geometry and separates object motion from camera motion.

paragraphs.en: The extractor also detects a state revisit when the compensated path length exceeds both 0.12 and three initial-object scales, the farthest displacement exceeds 2.5 scales, and the final displacement is less than 0.45 of the path length. An apparent death requires absence for at least two sampled frames; it is rejected as a normal boundary exit when the last visible centroid lies within 0.04 of an image boundary. Appearance change requires histogram similarity below 0.45 in at least two samples, while geometry change requires at least two samples whose area ratio is outside [ 0.42 , 2.4 ] [0.42,2.4] or aspect-ratio change is outside [ 0.5 , 2.0 ] [0.5,2.0] . These measurements are retained for diagnosis, while the final answer is produced by the fixed option-projection rules described below.
paragraphs.zh: 当补偿路径长度同时超过 0.12 和三个初始对象尺度，最远位移超过 2.5 个尺度，且最终位移小于路径长度的 0.45 倍时，提取器还会检测到状态重访。 明显的“死亡”状态要求目标至少连续两个采样帧中消失；如果最后一个可见质心位于图像边界 0.04 个尺度以内，则将其判定为正常的边界退出而非“死亡”。 外观变化要求至少两个样本中的直方图相似度低于 0.45，而几何变化则要求至少有两个样本的面积比超出 [0.42, 2.4] 范围，或长宽比变化超出 [0.5, 2.0] 范围。 这些测量值会被保留用于诊断，而最终答案则由下文描述的固定选项投影规则生成。

paragraphs.en: Mask propagation alone cannot increase the number of fixed IDs initialized at t = 0 t=0 and therefore cannot detect a genuinely new instance. For entity persistence, the system independently re-runs segmentation at an early sample, the midpoint, the penultimate sample, and the final sample. Initial instances are grouped by HSV appearance, area, and aspect ratio using descriptor similarity at least 0.78; re-detected masks are assigned to an initial instance at similarity at least 0.72. A repeated structure with at least four initial instances tolerates one extra segmentation component. A birth is retained when the same semantic cluster has an excess of at least two instances in at least two re-detection samples. Two terminal safeguards also retain a birth when multiple clusters grow and at least seven masks are unmatched, or when a positive count change co-occurs with at least ten unmatched terminal masks. A fusion/split candidate requires a tracked object of initial area at least 0.005 to shrink below 0.82 of its original area in at least two of its last three observations while an unmatched mask appears within normalized distance 0.12. These persistence requirements suppress one-frame mask fragmentation and color-only changes.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠掩码传播无法增加在 t = 0 时初始化的固定 ID 数量，因此也无法检测到真正的新实例。 为了实现实体持续性，系统会在早期样本、中间样本、倒数第二个样本和最终样本中独立地重新运行分割。 初始实例根据 HSV 外观、面积和宽高比，使用至少为 0.78 的描述符相似度进行分组；重新检测到的掩码在相似度至少为 0.72 时被分配给某个初始实例。 一个包含至少四个初始实例的重复结构可以容忍一个额外的分割组件。 当同一语义簇在至少两个重新检测样本中拥有至少两个多余的实例时，该新生实例会被保留。 两种终端保障机制也会在多个簇生长且至少有七个掩码未匹配时保留新生实例，或者当正向计数变化与至少十个未匹配的终端掩码同时出现时保留新生实例。 一个融合/分裂候选需要满足以下条件：一个初始面积至少为 0.005 的跟踪对象，在其最后三次观测中至少有两次面积缩小到原始面积的 0.82 以下，同时有一个未匹配的掩码出现在归一化距离 0.12 范围内。 这些持续性要求可以抑制单帧掩码碎片化和仅颜色变化的情况。

sents.en: A birth is retained when the same semantic cluster has an excess of at least two instances in at least two re-detection samples.
sents.zh: 当同一语义簇在至少两个重新检测样本中拥有至少两个多余的实例时，该新生实例会被保留。

sents.en: Two terminal safeguards also retain a birth when multiple clusters grow and at least seven masks are unmatched, or when a positive count change co-occurs with at least ten unmatched terminal masks.

sents.en: A fusion/split candidate requires a tracked object of initial area at least 0.005 to shrink below 0.82 of its original area in at least two of its last three observations while an unmatched mask appears within normalized distance 0.12.
sents.zh: 一个融合/分裂候选需要满足以下条件：一个初始面积至少为 0.005 的跟踪对象，在其最后三次观测中至少有两次面积缩小到原始面积的 0.82 以下，同时有一个未匹配的掩码出现在归一化距离 0.12 范围内。

sents.zh: 这些持续性要求可以抑制单帧掩码碎片化和仅颜色变化的情况。

paragraphs.en: The static branch computes Farnebäck optical flow between consecutive frames at 0.20 × 0.20\times scale and records median, 90th-, and 99th-percentile magnitudes and spatial spread. It also computes absolute consecutive-frame differences over the full image, the outer 10% border, the central 60% region, and the four corner thirds, together with histogram and edge-density changes. Separately, ORB correspondences between the first frame and four points across the rollout are fitted with partial affine RANSAC; transform magnitude, inlier ratio, and post-transform residual are retained as audit features. The classifier uses two signals: median dense-flow magnitude above 0.10 denotes broad camera/background motion, and the 95th percentile of the mean absolute grayscale difference in the central region above 2.0 denotes an anchored-region change.
paragraphs.zh: 静态分支以 0.20 × 0.20 的缩放比例计算连续帧之间的 Farnebäck 光流，并记录其幅值的中位数、第 90 百分位和第 99 百分位，以及空间分布情况。 它还计算整张图像、外围 10% 边界、中心 60% 区域以及四个角落三分之一区域的连续帧绝对差异，同时记录直方图和边缘密度变化。 此外，ORB 在第一帧与展开过程中四个点之间的对应关系通过部分仿射 RANSAC 进行拟合；变换幅值、内点比例和变换后的残差被保留为审计特征。 分类器使用两个信号：密集光流幅值的中位数超过 0.10 表示相机或背景存在大范围运动，而中心区域平均绝对灰度差异的第 95 百分位超过 2.0 则表示锚定区域发生了变化。

paragraphs.en: To convert these heterogeneous measurements into the benchmark’s closed answer spaces, we apply a frozen rule layer. Each subdimension is first assigned one or more violation signals using only evidence from the generated rollout; these signals are then projected to the exact option wording, with combined outcomes retained whenever the answer set provides such an option. Table 4 summarizes this deterministic decision layer.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将这些异构测量值转换为基准测试的封闭答案空间，我们应用了一个固定的规则层。 首先，每个子维度仅使用生成展开中的证据被分配一个或多个违规信号；然后，这些信号被投影到确切的选项措辞上，只要答案集提供了相应选项，就会保留组合结果。 表 4 总结了这一确定性决策层。

paragraphs.en: We validate the complete Hybrid evaluator on a question-definition-disjoint audit set of 100 generated-rollout questions, balanced to contain 20 questions from each diagnostic dimension and distributed across models and prompt levels. A human reviewer independently inspects the generated videos and selects an answer option, without being shown the evaluator prediction. We then compare this independent human answer with the evaluator prediction. Under this independent-annotation protocol, the Hybrid evaluator agrees with the human answer on 89 of 100 questions. The dimension-level results are reported in Table 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个由 100 个生成式问题组成的、与定义集分离的审计集上验证了完整的混合评估器；该审计集经过平衡处理，每个诊断维度包含 20 个问题，并分布在不同的模型和提示层级中。 一名人类评审员独立检查生成的视频并选择一个答案选项，而不会看到评估器的预测结果。 随后，我们将这一独立的人类答案与评估器的预测结果进行比较。 在这种独立标注协议下，混合评估器在 100 个问题中与人类答案一致的比例为 89 个。 各维度的结果报告于表 5 中。
